lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: Which category of roadway users is classified as 'vulnerable road users' under Texas traffic safety laws?

options.text: Operators of heavily armored commercial bank transport bullion trucks
Motorists driving modern sport utility vehicles with side curtain airbags
Interstate highway diesel freight haulers pulling dual trailer rigs
Pedestrians, bicyclists, roadside construction workers, and motorcycle riders
